description: This file defines the AppointmentService class which provides methods for managing appointment data in a Flutter healthcare application, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and canceling appointments via Supabase.

classes.name: AppointmentService
classes.description: A service class for performing CRUD operations and queries related to appointments.

methods.name: listForPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific patient by their ID.

methods.name: listForDoctor
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific doctor by their ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches an appointment by its unique ID.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Marks an appointment as canceled by updating its status.
